summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Builds embedded and edge software in Python and C++ that streams high-throughput image data through NVIDIA GPUs and runs machine learning inference on device, including a Jetson pipeline where TensorRT delivered a 5.2x detection speedup. Prior work spans an automated metal surface inspection pipeline and Linux-based distributed systems over WebSocket streaming.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis, combining image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation into one automated machine vision workflow.
Designed a custom wavelet bank (sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; with optimized homography stitching and concurrency, raised stitched-image PSNR from 65 to 86.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling at +/-8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with a Raspberry Pi over I2C and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF motion into HID commands in Python.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for on-device inference.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a three-layer distributed edge system (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO server, Jetson+Arduino controller) over a WebSocket fabric, with multiprocessing multi-camera capture feeding real-time image and command streaming.
Optimized YOLO detection on Jetson with TensorRT for a 5.2x speedup (56.7 to 10.9 ms, 17.6 to 92 FPS vs eager PyTorch), alongside faster-whisper STT and Gemini intent classification.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) to reach 100% pick reliability across 10 trials at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Cut inference from 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript) and 73.3ms (uncoalesced GPU) to 49.2ms, ~35% faster than naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.
Replaced TorchScript convolution layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights, and preallocated buffers to remove per-layer allocation overhead.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data pipelines using semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.

projects.name: ABB RobotStudio Automation Simulation
bullets: Simulated a full ABB workcell for a press-to-packing assembly line, programmed in RAPID with TCP socket-based pose acquisition and interrupt-driven press-bench logic.
